meta.homeTitle: Bénin AgroMarket — Market prices, finally legible
meta.homeDescription: 2007–2026 price history, seasonal patterns, and 3-month ahead forecasts with uncertainty intervals for white maize, tomato, and white yam across Benin's markets.
meta.explorerDescription: Explore historical price trajectories, monthly seasonal profiles, and spatial price spreads across Benin's Tier-1 staple markets.
meta.forecastDescription: 1-, 2-, and 3-month ahead retail price forecasts with 80% and 90% prediction intervals and holdout reliability diagnostics.
meta.methodDescription: Leakage-free rolling-origin evaluation protocol, baseline comparisons, NASA POWER weather ablation, and operational model limits.

maize_white.story: Storable grain with strong local month-to-month persistence: short-run moves stay tight, while seasonal tension widens in the unimodal North ahead of the autumn harvest.

tomatoes.story: Perishable horticultural crop subject to sharp seasonal swings: retail prices more than double between the September harvest trough and the May–June lean-season peak.

yam_white.story: Foundational staple tuber of Central and Northern Benin: supply tension peaks in July before new-harvest tubers arrive between August and October.
